fact: Between 7 and 13 May 2025 Djibouti deployed an electronic patient record for family planning, built on mSupply, with UNFPA and the Ministry of Health, replacing manual data handling in 23 public health facilities, and trained midwives and programme managers to use it; the record covers family planning only.
title: Djibouti améliore ses services de planification familiale grâce au dossier patient électronique MSupply
